title: An evolving theory: with a working spine, find the core problems and a programme of works (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Apply he fixes and record our definition. 

This is an evolving theory. There is no truth. We watch and learn. If we have a working spine that holds the process, we want to now find ways to move through this, identifying the core problems and then creating a programme of works to address the issues we know how to fix
